request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful sugary confectionery, bright, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy cotton-candy pink sugar glaze and frosting, colour #ffb8d8, shaded with a deeper rose pink #e58fb5; matte marshmallow white and cream; warm caramel, pale biscuit wafer and dark chocolate brown; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface; a few tiny pastel sprinkles and a little pale mint green trim.

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.

layers.text: Subject: Gummy Bear, a big chunky cute living gummy bear brawler standing upright on two short thick legs: the whole body is one piece of glossy translucent raspberry-pink gummy jelly, colour #f08fb8, shaded with a deeper rose pink, with big hard white highlights on its round belly and its head; a big round head with two small round ears, two round black dot eyes, a small snout and a wide cheerful grin; a fat round belly, two short thick arms raised with big round fists ready to punch; no fur, no claws, no clothes and no weapon; wide and heavy, bigger than a soldier; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a gummy sweet, not an animal.
The bear is drawn large and fills most of the width of the image.
